moments.author: Kyle Shanahan
moments.quote: I hit her… I don’t know why it was reported that way
moments.why: Shocking self-incrimination from the 49ers coach after a head‑on crash, dominating sports chatter among men

moments.author: Geno Smith
moments.quote: Regrets if I was a distraction to the team
moments.why: High‑profile QB humbles himself amid offseason controversy—fans and locker rooms talk about it

moments.author: FIFA / Gianni Infantino (via Reuters Sports)
moments.quote: Plans a $20 billion FIFA subsidiary offering up to 20 % stakes to investors
moments.why: Commercializing the World Cup outraged fans and execs, sparking widespread debate

moments.author: Mark Carney
moments.quote: I no longer have confidence in FIFA's Infantino
moments.why: A former central banker publicly denouncing FIFA leadership escalates the fallout
